findings.reason: the followup is the plan's only dispatch instruction, so §30 would never be dispatched and §29 would be built twice.
findings.text: f-wftl-008 is the plan's only open followup and it names §9, §22 and §29, but this version declares §29 `done` (plan.html:177, landed at `69ffd69fb9` per the s29 close comment) and adds §30 `implementable` (plan.html:180-181); its title and its `data-recommends-skill` invocation both point at the landed §29, so a coordinator following the plan's own handoff builds a finished section and no handoff names §30

findings.reason: the case as written is unsatisfiable by the described change and would send a worker either to fail its own gate or to rename a system-wide status vocabulary, so it must be scoped to the row's detail text.
findings.text: §30's done-when requires that "no row of the classification contains the word `producer`", but the row carries `classification: "producer-gone"` (asserted today at `tests/test_a_wait_whose_producer_is_gone_is_an_obligation.py:231-232`) and its obligation kind is `run-producer-gone` (`obligations.py:285`), so the case can only pass by renaming a status token and a duty kind that the Deliverable never asks for and that the shipped `a-broken-wait-reaches-its-coordinator` plan names by that same token

findings.reason: the gate cannot distinguish a complete reader from one that reads only lists, and the untested form is the one that collides with the port/pid rule.
findings.text: the Deliverable requires a job id passed "singly or as a comma-separated list" to be read as a job, but the only job-id case plants a three-id comma list, so the single-id form is never exercised — and it is the form the current reader refuses, because a bare digit is read as a job only under a job flag or a scheduler command "because a port and a pid are bare digits too" (`recovery_wait.py:861-865`); an implementation that handles only comma lists passes the whole gate while half the deliverable is untested

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py` and `reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py` both exist, `PRODUCER_GONE_STATUS`, `PRODUCER_GONE_DUTY_KIND` and the quoted row text resolve at `recovery_classification.py:445`, `obligations.py:285` and `recovery_classification.py:1754-1757`, and the cited run record `r-20261112T182638024068-h200-levers` exists under the crew home with the exact probe the Why quotes.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §30's third case requires that "no row of the classification contains the word `producer`", while the row's own `classification` field and its obligation kind are spelled `producer-gone` and `run-producer-gone`.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate writes the section's evidence fragment under `docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/`, where twenty-six sibling fragments already sit, and the cited landed record resolves at `docs/evidence/archive/work-flows-to-the-lane-landed.html#s29-finished-pending-landing-retires-its-run`.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §30's prose, its test filename and its symbols carry no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag, and its test name states the mechanism.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause is reproduced: `_wait_probe_job_id(["python","…/wait_jobs.py","1312389,1312390,1312391"])` returns `None` because a bare digit is read as a job only under a job flag or a scheduler command, and the cited manifest's wait is `valid: True` (its script path is a filesystem reference, so it reaches the classifier), which is how the run came to be classified `producer-gone` with the quoted row text.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §30 delivers one endpoint (a wait naming scheduler job ids is read as a wait on those jobs) and its final clause (the row names the run's own process) is the same row's honesty, not a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — f-wftl-008, the plan's only open followup, recommends building §29, which this version declares `done`, and names no followup for §30, which this version declares `implementable`, so a coordinator driving the plan from its open followup builds a landed section and never reaches §30.
